title: Sage turkey with cannellini
summary: Sage turkey with cannellini is a italian dinner built around turkey breast steaks and canned cannellini beans, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Pat turkey breast steaks dry and season it. Prep canned cannellini beans and fresh sage for Sage turkey with cannellini so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook turkey breast steaks on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook canned cannellini beans and fresh sage in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Sage turkey with cannellini before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice turkey breast steaks and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.
